plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes the Antikythera mechanism, an ancient device found in a shipwreck in the Aegean Sea, the stretch of water between Greece and Turkey. He calls it almost an astronomically aligned computer, which, as he tells it, would show that ancient people had far more advanced knowledge than we assume.
